Our Role

What We Do

Our Approach

Start from the bottom. Build upward.

We start with what exists on the ground, then build up — one step at a time.

Featured Projects

Building where the opportunity is.

A selection of the food-system opportunities Bottom Up Impact is developing on the ground.

Integrated food system In development
Ibeju-Lekki, Lagos

ALFSI

An integrated food-system initiative combining aquaponics, food processing, cold-chain infrastructure, skills development and market access to develop sustainable livelihood and food-security opportunities.

View Project →
Value chain In development
Dagbaja Oriade, Osun

Cocoa Aggregation

Working with an established cocoa farmers’ cooperative to build a stronger aggregation and market system, backed by solar-powered post-harvest infrastructure and better connectivity.

View Project →
Clean energy In development
Opialu, Benue

Cassava Last-Mile Systems

A clean-energy cassava processing machine and last-mile infrastructure connecting local production to processing and markets.

View Project →
